description.value:
You launch three projectiles at points you can see within range. Each creature within 10 feet of a detonation point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 fire damage and 3d6 kinetic damage, halved on a success; a creature caught in more than one blast radius is affected only once. Unattended flammable objects in the area ignite, and the blasts damage objects caught in them.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 6th level or higher, you launch four projectiles instead; at 8th level or higher, five.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
